## Gotchas / context for resume

- Device identity: stable USB serial is the persistent key; never commit real
  serials; mask in logs. Bus/device address is transient — never identity.
- Books live nested at `documents/Downloads/Items01/` (58 `.kfx`), dictionaries
  at `documents/dictionaries/`; a restored sideload lives at `documents/` root —
  inventory scans the whole `documents/` tree.
- Per-book metadata (`.mf`/`.yjf`/`.meta`) lives inside each `.sdr` sidecar
  folder and carries delivery/caching data only (no titles/authors/covers).
- On Linux, GVFS (`gvfsd-mtp`) may claim the MTP interface → device-busy; check
  with `ps -ef | grep -Ei '[g]vfsd-mtp'` before physical-device tests.
- Do not push/promote/ship without explicit request; staged model
  development → staging → main.
